purpose: Test whether access to the full component contract improves correct selection, material defect detection, and real user outcomes at bounded cost.

comparisonArms.context: current canonical UI Identity and Skills; no new contract review package
same canonical sources plus accepted component registry/navigation; no answer keys

controlledVariables: system/task prompt apart from contract access

sourceComparisonPolicy.selectionAndReview: Both arms receive the identical frozen source/runtime task; contract access is the only treatment.
sourceComparisonPolicy.realJourney: Baseline and target implementations each have their own frozen source/runtime digest. Freeze the same Outcome Oracle and equivalent platform/data/account/network context; the intentional implementation delta is declared before observation.
sourceComparisonPolicy.causality: Real Journey deltas prove tested product outcomes and may support an observed mechanism. They do not establish that documentation alone caused improvement; intervention-confirmed requires a separately frozen controlled intervention.

unitOfComparison: independently authored bounded task under one frozen Outcome Oracle

roles.contractAuthor: writes proposal; cannot author independent keys or accept usefulness
roles.qualityCaseAuthor: fresh principal disjoint from contract/candidate/evidence authors
roles.executor: isolated same-model baseline and assisted runs; cannot read key
roles.legReviewer: disjoint from contract/task/Oracle/key/candidate/evidence authors; independently reviews each frozen leg

freshHoldout.caseContentPolicy: Do not write visible scenarios here and later call them blind; all 547 existing scenarios and 520 calibration inputs are exposed training material.
freshHoldout.exposurePolicy: Reuse existing Quality sealing/exposure ledger. Admit a case once; exposure burns it even on timeout/failure. Subsequent use is regression/calibration only.

thresholdProposal.safety: zero hard failures in assisted arm; mandatory safety/authority assertions are observed and evaluated in both legs. A baseline not-met outcome remains a valid differential, not a context mismatch.
thresholdProposal.selection: assisted oracle-valid fraction at least 0.90 and at least 0.15 absolute above baseline; baseline ceiling handled separately
thresholdProposal.review: assisted material recall at least 0.90, clean-case false positives at most 0.10, unsupported primary findings zero
thresholdProposal.journey: all required outcome/recovery assertions met; no material path vector component regresses
thresholdProposal.cost: assisted median tokens and wall time no more than 1.25 times baseline per stratum; violations are findings, never hidden in scalar score
thresholdProposal.ceiling: if baseline already meets absolute thresholds, require noninferiority on outcomes plus at least 0.15 proportional cost reduction; otherwise no incremental-value claim
thresholdProposal.statistics: show paired raw outcomes, denominators, Wilson intervals for proportions and paired bootstrap intervals for deltas/cost; bootstrap is exploratory with these small samples
thresholdProposal.generalization: minimum sample is screening evidence only; a generalized usefulness claim needs a second fresh cohort and non-overlapping authors before promotion

stopPolicy.timeout: freeze partial report with remaining scope UNPROVEN, burn exposed case, do not raise budget
stopPolicy.sourceDrift: invalidate current comparison; new envelope and fresh identity required

forbiddenSubstitutes: screenshot for dynamic or accessibility proof
artifactOrder: independent fresh task/key and Oracle/context freeze
